bird with prominent beak in profile
anthropomorphic figure with arms and hands rendered
justification: Both surfaces are flat slabs carved in low relief with profile figures, and each includes a round disc/rosette-like element and a beaked bird in profile, but these are generic correspondences. A shows a stacked assemblage of schematic animals (quadruped, snake-like forms, birds, small crouching figure) with no dominant actor, whereas B is dominated by a single large naturalistically modelled winged human figure in striding profile holding attributes, an entirely different compositional scheme and level of anatomical detail.
